capabilities: Export the note preview to a selectable-text PDF with page size, margins, headers, footers, and color options
Export notes as DOCX, PPTX, PNG, and self-contained HTML with images, links, and layout layers
Write NoteDraw strokes as editable PDF ink annotations
Export Excalidraw drawings as image PDFs with page slicing
Set the interface language to Auto, Chinese, or English
extras: Not yet in the official community plugin browser; install from GitHub releases or via BRAT. The author offers paid custom development of the plugin. The manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian.
problem: Obsidian mobile has no one-click PDF export that keeps the rendered preview layout with selectable, copyable text.

relations.evidence: Exports direct .excalidraw.md files as pure image PDFs through the Excalidraw runtime
Exports persisted NoteDraw text, styled nodes, connectors, images, videos, attachments, and strokes
Markor creates PDF through Android WebView printing, so its preview PDF text is selectable

summary: Export plugin that renders the active note preview into a selectable-text, phone-width PDF, and can also export DOCX, PPTX, PNG, and self-contained HTML on mobile and desktop.
